transcript:
DAVID: 	Why can I smell burning hair?	(Pause, shift in tone)	I smell burning hair. 

MARTIN: What? Talk to me, man!

DAVID: Oh no...

MARTIN: What is going-

DAVID: Judith. Poor Judith.

MARTIN: 	Who’s Judith?! 	
David? Is someone else with you?	David?	
You’re starting to scare me...


DAVID: I shouldn’t have done this... No good can come of it...

[SFX: David’s voice slowly starts to drift further away from the phone, his voice getting quiet and quieter.]

[Pause]

DAVID: Her eyes... The fire took her eyes... But she is still looking at me... She is seeing me... She tries to speak... but the fire is stealing her breath.
